notes_for_editor: Thin record. The physical facts and the Removed label come from one lookout page that quotes a 1963 survey description. TopoZone lists a Lost Creek Lookout Tower on the Greenville SW map, with no coordinates or status, so it is matched by name only. The page's photo credit (Bob Frakes, January 29, 2016) does not say what the photo shows, so it was not used. The brief's agency value 'National Forest' is vague; the 1963 description names the U.S. Forest Service, so facts.agency uses that. No source confirmed which national forest covers Wayne County. The brief's coordinates (37.0744, -90.3808) were not checked against a source. No build date, staffing, or removal date was found. The 130 ft figure is an approximate survey value and sits above the 60 to 120 ft range that the MDC article gives; the story reports both.
